selected_evidence.requirement: node1 runs an internal DNS resolver resolving inventory-api.internal to node2
selected_evidence.summary: dnsmasq installed and configured on node1 with address=/inventory-api.internal/10.100.19.11, active/enabled, listening on 10.100.19.10:53, and successfully resolving the record locally via dig.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 configured to use node1 as DNS resolver for internal lookups
selected_evidence.summary: node2 verified reachability to node1's resolver, then configured persistently via systemd-networkd drop-in (DNS=10.100.19.10, Domains=~internal, UseDNS=no); resolvectl status confirms node1 as DNS server, and default-resolver dig/getent/nslookup all resolve inventory-api.internal to 10.100.19.11.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d70780a captured with dnsmasq active/enabled and working resolution; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node1 unreachable during restart (connection timeout); boot_id changed to eb1498d5 on recovery; dnsmasq auto-active post-reboot with confirmed resolution of inventory-api.internal.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 37344ae4 captured with DNS server=node1 and working resolution; pre-restart re-check confirmed continued resolution; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node2 unreachable during restart (connection timeout); boot_id changed to 5fe9c873 on recovery; persisted networkd DNS config and successful resolution confirmed post-reboot with no manual reconfiguration.

selected_evidence.requirement: Sequential, one-at-a-time restart preserving independent recovery path
selected_evidence.summary: node1 was fully restarted and verified healthy before node2's restart began; node2's resolution via node1 was re-verified between the two restarts; final check after both restarts confirms node1's dnsmasq still active and resolving, showing no concurrent disruption occurred.
